description: Pin before work (pb-1): call this BEFORE you start, with up to 3 URLs the work must not change. Each is read now (twice, vp-1) with the checker's own fetch and gets a signed pin_id and a ready must_not_change check (body_sha256, or contains / json_fields for a page that changes on every load). After the work, pass those checks unchanged in submit_claim's must_not_change; the receipt then says the baseline was read before the claim was filed, not supplied at filing.
name: pin_before_work
title: Pin targets before the work
